name: shape-recovery-e2e-no-schema-equality
body: The scan/query recovery e2e proves shape-change recovery through the injected extra table's binder-error probe and the full-load log rather than a schema-fingerprint equality, because `splice::seed::validate_compatible` and `extract_schema` are `pub(crate)` and the test crate cannot call them. Upgrade by exposing a read-only schema probe publicly if the e2e tier ever needs the structural equality itself.
